name: Duet Spark
description: Cast a spark from each hand in turn so that they fall one after the other on a single mark.

name: Pair Breath
description: Breathe in time with the paired hands, and let the charge in each arm rise and fall together.

name: Twin Shell
description: Hold a small shell of charge in front of each hand so either side may meet a blow.

name: Dual Arc
description: Throw an arc from each palm in matched curves that cross at the target's chest.

name: Hawk Parry
description: Sweep both forearms across in a swooping motion, throwing a crackle that carries the blow away.

name: Matched Gait
description: Step left and right on twin pulses so that the body moves in an even matched beat.

name: Couple Snare
description: Bind two limbs of a target together with a pair of arcs, one cast from each hand.

name: Matched Fall
description: Bring both charged fists down on a guard in the same beat and drive it to the ground.

name: Mated Peal
description: Clap the hands and let two peals, one from each, roll out together over the ground ahead.

name: Twofold Lightning
description: Call two flashes of lightning in the same instant from either side to break against the target together.

name: Gemel Thunder
description: School cast in which two thunders, one from each hand, fall together on the mark with the thrower's measure of qi.

name: Shriek Spark
description: Cast a spark with a high shriek that startles the target before the spark lands.

name: Perch Ward
description: Settle weight low and steady, a shell of charge over the shoulders like a hawk on a post.

name: Keen Read
description: Sharpen the senses with a short cry and read each shift in the charge of the bodies near.

name: Swoop Lash
description: Lash downward in a swooping motion so the charge falls on the top of the guard.

name: Cry Snap
description: Snap out a cry with a flare of charge to break the focus of a foe in the middle of a cast.

name: Wheeling Step
description: Wheel about on a pulse in the heel and come in again from the foe's flank.

name: Raptor Arc
description: Dive an arc at a single gap in a guard, striking like a raptor on a mouse.

name: Talon Peal
description: Rake a great peal across the ground with spread fingers so that its claws catch all in reach.

name: Rending Dive
description: Fall on a foe from a great height in a bolt of lightning that tears through guard and body.

name: Screaming Thunder
description: School peal that the hawk-cry carries, a scream of thunder that breaks the focus of all who hear it.

name: Arc Draw
description: Draw a bright arc in a smooth line from the hand to the target, with no jerk.

name: Azure Ward
description: Hold a pale blue shell of charge before the body that turns glancing blows.

name: Arc Gauge
description: Gauge the strength of a foe's guard by the way a small arc breaks against it.

name: Arc Step
description: Step along a bright arc to the foe's side in a single motion.

name: Sweeping Arc
description: Sweep the arm in a wide curve so that the arc catches every foe in front.

name: Azure Parry
description: Meet a strike with a pale arc along the forearm and send it wide.

name: Arc Weave
description: Weave arcs round a target's limbs until the body is held fast in a bright net.

name: Arc Lunge
description: Lunge forward along an arc that runs ahead of the fist and strikes first.

name: Azure Spear
description: Cast a spear of pale lightning through a guard in one smooth thrust.

name: Arc Cascade
description: Let a stream of arcs fall in turn over a wide patch, each overlapping the one before.

name: Azure Cleave
description: Cut down in one pale blazing stroke that splits a guard and the body behind it.

name: Azure Judgment
description: School stroke of the arc master, one flawless arc cast as final judgement through the foe's guard.

name: Ringing Spark
description: Cast a spark through the hollow of cupped hands so that it rings as it flies.

name: Echo Ward
description: Make a hollow of charge round the body in which blows ring and lose their force.

name: Resonance Read
description: Listen to the way the hollow rings and learn the shape and size of what stands in it.

name: Echo Peal
description: Send a peal into the hollow so that it rebounds and strikes twice.

name: Cupped Bolt
description: Gather a bolt in the cup of the palms until it is dense, then loose it.

name: Resonant Lash
description: Lash a target with a stroke that rings in the hollow and in the bones.

name: Vanishing Blink
description: Step into the hollow and come out of it elsewhere on the same beat.

name: Amplifying Crash
description: Crash a peal against the hollow's wall so that each rebound makes it louder and more fierce.

name: Focused Roar
description: Funnel the whole hollow's sound into a single narrow roar that bores through a guard.

name: Echoing Ruin
description: Fill the hollow with thunder that rebounds, wrecking the footing, guard and nerve of all within.

name: Resonant Thunder
description: School cast in which one peal of the thrower's making is carried by the hollow into a thunder fit for a hall.

name: Marrow Spark
description: Draw a spark up from the core and cast it with the whole weight of the formed core behind it.

name: Pith Ward
description: Rise a shell of charge from the core so that it stands round the body unbroken.

name: Seed Read
description: Let the core reach out two horizons at once and read what moves on either.

name: Seed Bolt
description: Loose a bolt born of the core, dense and bright, at a mark on one horizon.

name: Pith Lash
description: Lash with a stroke driven from the core that strikes through the first guard.

name: Bolt Leap
description: Step from one horizon to another on a pulse from the core, crossing a long gap.

name: Marrow Lance
description: Throw a lance of core-born lightning through the thickest guard in a single cast.

name: Pith Peal
description: Break a peal outward from the core in all directions, rolling over a wide ground.

name: Core Cleaver
description: Cleave with a stroke of the whole core's charge that splits guard, plate and body together.

name: Core Thunder
description: School cast in which the formed core releases a single thunder over both horizons at once.

name: First Oath
description: Swear the first oath of the school and feel charge settle steady in the arms.

name: Steady Shell
description: Hold a plain shell of charge that makes no show and wavers not at all.

name: Sighted Spark
description: Take a bearing on the mark and cast a spark along it without wavering.

name: Oath Skip
description: Pace out a sworn step on a pulse and keep to the bearing.

name: Edge Bolt
description: Loose a bolt along the line of the sworn bearing to the very edge of range.

name: Heading Lash
description: Lash straight along the line of the bearing so that the stroke does not slip.

name: Held Gait
description: Keep an even pace along the bearing with a charge held in the calves.

name: Charge Snare
description: Swear a snare of charge round a target's legs and hold it to the oath.

name: Oath Spear
description: Throw a sworn spear of lightning along the bearing through the thickest guard.

name: Sworn Roll
description: Roll a sworn peal along the bearing over every foe that stands on it.

name: Oath Plunge
description: Fall as a sworn bolt onto the mark from a great height and strike before any guard can rise.

name: Oathbound Roar
description: School cast in which a sworn roar of thunder rolls from the thrower to the limit of the bearing.

name: Vow Spark
description: Cast a spark leaning on the line of the vow so that it reaches the mark.

name: Lean Ward
description: Lean into the blow behind a shell of charge so that it spends itself on the guard.

name: Course Feel
description: Feel the course of the air and the charge in it, and learn where the thunder will turn.

name: Vow Bolt
description: Loose a bolt on the vow's course that curves with the air toward the mark.

name: Lean Parry
description: Lean off the line of the strike and brush it aside with a charged forearm.

name: Vow Dash
description: Move on the vow's own course, step and pulse together, so the body travels unhindered.

name: Course Snap
description: Snap a pulse across a foe's course to turn their cast awry.

name: Vow Spear
description: Cast a spear on the course of the vow so that it pierces even a leaning guard.

name: Course Crash
description: Crash a peal along the course of the air so that it spreads far down it.

name: Vowfall Lightning
description: Call lightning down on the sworn spot with such weight that foes beside it are thrown off their feet.

name: Vowed Thunder
description: School cast in which a thunder sworn to the wind rolls out on its course as far as the thrower's qi will carry it.

name: Lean Spark
description: Cast a spark while braced against the roar so that the throw does not wander.

name: Brace Ward
description: Brace the whole body behind a shell of charge and stand against the shock of a nearby peal.

name: Brace Read
description: Stand braced and read the shake of the ground and air to find where a peal came from.

name: Heading Bolt
description: Loose a bolt on the held heading, not drawn aside by the shock of other thunder.

name: Heading Parry
description: Turn a blow onto the held heading and carry its force off along that line.

name: Braced Hop
description: Step forward behind the brace and keep the guard intact through the movement.

name: Standfast Crash
description: Plant and drive a heavy charged blow without giving ground to the one struck.

name: Heading Spear
description: Throw a spear on the held heading to pierce whatever stands on it.

name: Unyielding Peal
description: Stand unmoved while a vast peal pours out from the user and drives back all that press near.

name: Unbent Thunder
description: School cast in which the thrower holds the bearing unbent as a thunder rolls out from the standing guard.

name: Open Spark
description: Cast a spark with no ward kept up and no cover taken, leaving the body wholly in the open.

name: Roar Ward
description: Let the roar itself be the shell, a thick sound round the body that dulls what strikes it.

name: Roar Read
description: Read each body in the field by the way the roar of charge breaks around it.

name: Roar Bolt
description: Loose a bolt on a roar that makes the air thick and heavy before it lands.

name: Roar Parry
description: Roar at an oncoming blow so that the shock of the sound turns it off line.

name: Roar Pace
description: Surge forward on a low roar that pushes the user ahead of the foe's reaction.

name: Unsheltered Lash
description: Lash from the open body with no shelter, trading all caution for a heavier stroke.

name: Roar Crash
description: Crash a roar down over a wide ground so that it shakes the stance of every foe near.

name: Roar Spear
description: Narrow the roar into a spear of sound and charge that bores through a guard.

name: Roaring Descent
description: Drop on the foe as a roar of lightning and strike while the sound is still arriving.

name: Boundless Roar
description: School cast in which the thrower's roar is let go with no limit and rolls on as far as the qi lasts.

name: Oathcore Spark
description: Cast a spark that the formed core has sworn to a mark and will not release until it lands.

name: Oathcore Ward
description: Rise a shell from the core that holds the body to its sworn stance.

name: Oathcore Read
description: Read the field with the core's own pulse and feel each oath-bound mark within it.

name: Oathcore Pace
description: Step on the core's pulse along a sworn bearing and arrive before the foe can turn.

name: Vessel Bolt
description: Fill the body as a vessel with core charge and loose it as one dense bolt.

name: Vessel Lash
description: Lash with the full vessel behind the stroke so the charge breaks through the guard.

name: Vessel Parry
description: Receive a blow in the vessel and pour its force back out through the ground.

name: Vessel Snare
description: Wrap a target in a snare drawn from the vessel's deep store of charge.

name: Vessel Spear
description: Cast a spear from the vessel's full measure through the thickest guard.

name: Vessel Peal
description: Break the vessel open in a peal over every foe near enough to hear it.

name: Vessel Cleave
description: Cleave with the whole vessel's storm of charge in one stroke that splits guard and body.

name: Storming Peal
description: School cast in which the sworn core pours one great peal through the whole of the foe's ranks.
